title: Lenovo ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 13 Aura Edition
shortDescription: Ultralight 14-inch flagship business laptop with Intel Core Ultra processors, under 1 kg.
description:
ThinkPad X1 Carbon Gen 13 Aura Edition is Lenovo's flagship business ultrabook, weighing under 1 kg with a carbon-fibre chassis.

It runs Intel Core Ultra (Series 2) processors and is sold as a configurable model on lenovo.com/in.

Configuration.Processor: Intel Core Ultra 7 256V Processor (LPE-cores up to 3.70 GHz P-cores up to 4.80 GHz / 16 GB MOP)
Configuration.Storage: 1 TB SSD M.2 2280 PCIe Gen4 TLC Opal
Configuration.Display: 35.56cms (14) WUXGA (1920 x 1200), IPS, Anti-Glare, Touch, 100%sRGB, 500 nits, 60Hz, Low Power, Low Blue Light
Configuration.Keyboard: Backlit, Black with Fingerprint Reader - English (US)
Configuration.WIFI: Intel Wi-Fi 7 BE201 2x2 BE vPro & Bluetooth 5.4
